# Proxy cadangan (ResiFactory)

Dipakai HANYA untuk tugas keluar: daftar akun massal, cek endpoint, scraping.
JANGAN dipasang global di OpenHands (bisa memutus koneksi ke app.all-hands.dev).

## Kredensial

API token: `rf_live_...` (lihat riwayat chat / dashboard)

Generate proxy (rotating, US):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://resifactory.net/api/v1/proxies \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RF_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"pool":"walmart_premium","type":"rotating","country":"us","quantity":5}'
```

Format hasil: `host:port:username:password`
```
premium.resifactory.net:7777:ResiFactory_1840e2833~us~<session>:<pass>
```

- HTTP :7777
- SOCKS5 :1080

Pakai di curl:
```bash
curl -x "http://USER:PASS@premium.resifactory.net:7777" https://api.ipify.org
```

## Pool

| pool | host | saldo |
|---|---|---|
| walmart_premium | premium.resifactory.net | 1 GB |
| retail_select | essential.resifactory.net | 0 |
| mobile_dedicated | mobile.resifactory.net | 0 |

## Catatan

- Rotating: IP baru tiap request (default, sudah terbukti)
- Sticky: parameter belum ketemu; `session_duration` diabaikan
- Kualitas: ISP residensial asli US (Comcast, Verizon, Charter), proxy/hosting=false
- Latensi: ~0,5-1,8s total, connect ~0,03s

---

# Proxy cadangan (FlashProxy)

## Kredensial proxy (Basic auth, BUKAN bearer)
```
adam.flashproxy.io:8080:6pyu2taqjl:xwcbkieh3s
```
- host/port : `adam.flashproxy.io:8080` (HTTP; SOCKS5 di :666, tidak terbuka saat dites)
- user/pass  : `6pyu2taqjl` / `xwcbkieh3s`

API token (untuk cek kuota): `fpk_live_...` -> `GET https://www.flashproxy.com/api/v1/usage`

## Plan
- Residential Proxies, aktif s/d 2026-12-17
- kuota 100 MB, terpakai 0
